scripts.scrape-6mo: node run-env.js MAX_PAGES=40 MAX_AGE_MONTHS=6 HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.scrape-6mo-list: node run-env.js MAX_PAGES=40 MAX_AGE_MONTHS=6 FETCH_CONTACT_DETAILS=false SCRAPE_ONLY=true HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.turbo-list: node run-env.js TURBO_MODE=true MAX_PAGES=13 MAX_AGE_DAYS=5 PARALLEL_LIST_PAGES=3 FETCH_CONTACT_DETAILS=false SCRAPE_ONLY=true HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.resume-turbo: node run-env.js TURBO_MODE=true START_PAGE=33 MAX_PAGES=40 MAX_AGE_MONTHS=6 PARALLEL_LIST_PAGES=3 FETCH_CONTACT_DETAILS=false RESUME_CHECKPOINT=true SCRAPE_ONLY=true HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.turbo-enrich: node run-env.js TURBO_ENRICH=true ENRICH_CONCURRENCY=4 HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.turbo-enrich-full: node run-env.js TURBO_ENRICH=true ENRICH_CONCURRENCY=4 HEADLESS=false -- scraper.js
scripts.turbo-full: npm run turbo-list && node skip-bad-seek-row.cjs && npm run turbo-enrich
scripts.test-env: node -e "import 'dotenv/config'; const p=process.env.SEEK_PASSWORD; console.log('length:', p?.length); console.log('endsWith#:', p?.endsWith('#'));"
